In `ext/Chat/readme.md` the picture's alt text says "the three views at 360 px", but the picture shows V3 only. Also, the two new "Files that matter" bullets sit before a blank line, which splits that list in two.

The V3 reply text has looser lines (`.chat-v3-text` line-height 1.45) than V2's sentence replies, and it leaves a bigger gap above ▶ ↺10. Compare screens/v3-360.png band 3 with screens/v2-360.png band 3: the same reply runs about 50px against 40px a line.

At 1920 the chat column is only about 630px wide (x 310–940). About 630px of empty page sits to its right (screens/v3-1920.png, all bands). The 80% cap is 80% of that narrow column, so the long pill is 499px. This is the page's own measure and was there before this diff, but it is why the owner sees "80%" as about a quarter of the screen.
